cards.title: Open ASR Leaderboard Adds Egyptian and Nigerian English Accent Benchmarks via Liva AI
cards.why_it_matters: For engineers building or evaluating speech recognition systems, more private held-out accent splits reduce benchmark overfitting and expose real performance gaps across underrepresented English varieties.
cards.summary: Hugging Face's Open ASR Leaderboard gains two new private evaluation splits — Egyptian and Nigerian English — contributed by Liva AI, which collects naturalistic multimodal data through consumer products. The leaderboard now structures accent coverage using Kachru's Three Circles framework, reporting US vs. non-US and Inner Circle vs. Outer/Expanding Circle breakdowns. Private data minimizes benchmarking-to-leaderboard gaming.

cards.title: Hugging Face Launches ToyBlocks: A Controlled Simulation Framework for Studying Robot Learning
cards.why_it_matters: If you work on robot learning, world models, or sim-to-real transfer, ToyBlocks provides a reproducible, automatically-annotated benchmark environment designed specifically for isolating and diagnosing model behavior — exactly the kind of controlled testbed the field has lacked.
cards.summary: ToyBlocks is Hugging Face's first 'FoundationWorld': a tabletop block-manipulation simulator with realistic physics, automatic demonstration generation via RL and motion planning, and domain randomization. It separates high-level reasoning from low-level motor control, enables controlled data-ablation experiments, and targets sim-to-real fidelity without human teleoperation. Part of a broader FoundationWorlds framework built atop MolmoAct 2, MolmoBot, and MolmoSpaces.

cards.title: Provably Threshold-Error-Correcting Circuits for Non-Abelian Topological Quantum Memory
cards.why_it_matters: For researchers tracking quantum error correction, this is a significant theoretical result: a proven circuit-level noise threshold for non-abelian topological phases, a class previously lacking such rigorous guarantees.
cards.summary: The paper presents an explicit scheme for quantum memory in any 2D non-chiral topological order. It constructs syndrome extraction circuits from the Turaev-Viro path integral, pairs them with an on-the-fly classical decoder, and proves the existence of a threshold under local stochastic circuit-level noise. The scheme is also designed to generalize to topological logical gate implementation.
